question: The dataset contains only paired-end FASTQ reads (6 samples: 3 treated vs 3 control, human liver) — no count matrix — and the sandbox has no read aligner or pseudoaligner installed (STAR, hisat2, bwa, minimap2, salmon, kallisto, and featureCounts are all absent; nothing installs at run time), so the quantification step needed to answer "which genes are differentially expressed" cannot be built from what is available. Which of these can be provided? (1) Provision a quantifier in the sandbox — salmon or kallisto (lightest) plus a human transcriptome FASTA for GRCh38 (GENCODE, e.g. v50; the GRCh38.p13 genome FASTA and the GENCODE v50 GTF are already provisioned, so a transcriptome can be derived from them if needed), or STAR plus featureCounts; or (2) provide a precomputed gene count matrix (gene x 6 samples, with sample names matching metadata.csv) from the original experiment pipeline, in which case the plan starts directly at DESeq2.
